_doc: /amazon search (docs/briefs/AMAZON_SEARCH.md, decision 101). stores: the Amazons searched (keys of market/stores.md amazon_<key>). routes_per_store comes from market/stores.md modes x market/tariffs.json. top_per_store: how many cards per store get a product-page read (seller, weight, exact delivery); the rest are not shown. max_searches_per_day: /amazon runs per local day (one run = one search page per store + product pages); cooldown_hours: a store that showed a check page is not opened again for this long. pause_s: polite pause range between page loads. browser_wait_s: how long a run waits for the bot's browser when the nightly market scan holds it. assumed_kg: weight used when the page lists none (said in UPPERCASE). claude_model: cheaper model for the two small calls (plan, pick reason). trust: weights of the trust score (amazon/trust.py) - seller class points, rating points only with min_reviews reviews, review-count and 'bought in past month' evidence (3*log10, capped), badges, sponsored penalty; band: results whose scores fall in the same band are ordered by delivered price. keep_last_hours: /amazon last. Prime is not a ranking input (brief 1.1). avoid_words: seasonal/costume listings are left out of the candidates unless the person's own words contain the word (owner-editable, like China's brand lists); skipped when fewer than top_per_store results would remain.
